{'text': 'Apple 持續改善 Apple TV 4K 上的用戶設定檔功能，而 tvOS 27 中一項與 app 取用權限相關的改動，提供了另一個使用設定檔的理由。', 'source': 'Apple continues to improve user profile features on Apple TV 4K, and a change related to app access in tvOS 27 provides another reason to use profiles.'}

{'text': 'tvOS 27 讓你可以限制用戶開啟特定的 app', 'source': 'tvOS 27 lets you restrict users from opening specific apps'}

{'text': '用戶設定檔是各大串流平台常見的功能。除了其他好處之外，它能確保同住的家庭成員各自保持獨立的觀看記錄和推薦內容。', 'source': 'User profiles are a common feature across major streaming platforms. Among other benefits, they ensure that members of the same household maintain separate watch histories and recommendations.'}

{'text': 'Apple 早就在 tvOS 中加入設定檔功能，但過去一年經過多項更新後，這項功能變得更加實用。', 'source': 'Apple added profile support to tvOS long ago, but a series of updates over the past year has made the feature significantly more useful.'}

{'text': '現在 tvOS 27 帶來了另一項改進。根據 Apple 官方的發佈說明：', 'source': 'Now tvOS 27 brings another improvement. According to Apple’s official release notes:'}

{'text': '這項改動顯然是為家長而設的。', 'source': 'This change is clearly aimed at parents.'}

{'text': '兒童設定檔本來就可以限制他們在 Apple TV app 中看到的內容類型。這是個實用的功能，但卻無法阻止小朋友打開另一個沒有相關限制的 app。', 'source': 'Kids profiles could already restrict the type of content they see in the Apple TV app. That’s a useful feature, but it doesn’t stop a child from opening another app that doesn’t have similar restrictions.'}

{'text': '不過現在，家長可以打開「設定」，在小朋友的設定檔啟用時，封鎖特定 app 讓其完全無法開啟。', 'source': 'Now, however, parents can head into Settings and block specific apps from opening entirely when a child’s profile is active.'}

{'text': '這是讓設定檔功能更加完善的一個好進展，也配合了 Apple 近期在 iOS 27 中升級家長監護功能的重心。', 'source': 'It’s a welcome step toward making the profile feature more complete, and it aligns with Apple’s recent focus on upgrading parental controls in iOS 27.'}

{'text': '說到設定檔的改進，iOS 27.2 和 iPadOS 27.2 將首次把 Apple 的設定檔系統帶到 iPhone 和 iPad。你可以在此閱讀相關介紹。', 'source': 'Speaking of profile improvements, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 will bring Apple’s profile system to iPhone and iPad for the first time. You can read about that here.'}

{'text': '你會在 Apple TV 上使用設定檔嗎？你希望新增哪些功能？歡迎在評論區告訴我們。', 'source': 'Will you use profiles on Apple TV? What features do you want added? Tell us in the comments.'}
